stemMarkdown: 16 workers, each working 7 hours a day, can complete a job in 16 days. How many days will 16 workers, each working 9 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 16 \times 16 \times 7$ worker-hours $= 1792$. With 16 workers at 9 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{1792}{16\times9} = 12.44$.
